a.lede: The $43 billion loan is structured as a unique arrangement in which a different company buys the Nvidia chips, while SpaceX makes quarterly payments to use them.
a.title: Lenders back SpaceX's $43 billion Nvidia GPU deal but worry the collateral could end up in orbit, making them impossible to reclaim if Musk defaults

b.lede: Bondholders want SpaceX’s valuable chip collateral kept on Earth and within reach.
b.title: SpaceX lenders don’t want Elon Musk launching their collateral into space
